listing.name: Robox — robox-recompiled (Eggscantfly)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream native runtime/game features and local title setup/mod/save behavior described. Release build required for audio pacing; Debug too slow. Clean source build needs original font assets up front; broad gameplay/completion and package integrity not Portcove-qualified. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Before configuring source build, supply own unpacked Robox USA.dol plus Assets/fonts/title.brfna and other original Assets. Original data stays user-owned. Runtime importer can accept owned WAD plus Wii common key or manually selected DOL+Assets, but that importer cannot bootstrap its own clean source build without pre-unpacked font assets.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Documented manual source route: obtain WiiRecomp source, supply own unpacked DOL and original Assets before CMake configure, then Windows/MSYS2 mingw64 CMake/Ninja Release build or build.bat. ROBOX_DOL/ROBOX_RECOMPILER may locate owned input/compiler. Do not claim WAD-only clean checkout build or offer an unverified precompiled game package. No upstream code or assets executed here.
